title: Breaking the Entanglement-Structure Trade-off: Many-Body Localization Protects Emergent Holographic Geometry in Random Tensor Networks
abstract_summary: Demonstrates that many-body localization (MBL) resolves the fundamental tension between spatial entanglement structure and mutual information in random tensor networks, sustaining emergent holographic geometry indefinitely against thermalization. Near-Ising anisotropy with specific disorder strength gives optimal conditions. Verifies the 'entanglement → geometry → gravity' chain from ER=EPR in a disordered XXZ model.
relevance_reason: Directly confirms holographic geometry emergence from entanglement in tensor networks, supporting our MERA holographic force results. MBL protection mechanism is novel and could apply to our chi=3 MERA stability.
connection_to_project: Confirms ER=EPR chain in random tensor networks; MBL-protected geometry is a new stabilization route complementary to our ALM+projection method. Relevant to HYP-2026-009 (chi=3 phase transitions).
